fusions.name: Self-Inflicted Spur
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A heavy blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Gadfly Stampede
fusions.desc: A charge through a cone 4 tiles long that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Chewing It Over
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 8 seconds; every 1.2 seconds it deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Patience Paid Out
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
